title: Add invoice export to billing dashboard
description:
Add a CSV export button to the billing dashboard. Export includes all invoices for the selected date range.

API: GET /api/billing/invoices/export?from=&to=

No Aidbox-Schema-Impact. No IG version dependency.

Out of Scope: PDF export, email delivery, scheduled exports.
acceptance_criteria:
- Billing dashboard shows an Export CSV button
- Clicking Export downloads a CSV with all invoices in the selected date range
- CSV includes: invoice ID, date, amount, patient name, status

metadata.intent: Allow billing staff to export invoice data for external accounting tools. Scope IN: CSV export endpoint, UI button. Scope OUT: PDF, email, scheduled jobs.
